sloka: इति ते राम सम्मन्त्र्य सर्वोद्योगेन राक्षसाः ।युद्धाय निर्ययुः सर्वे महाकाया महाबलाः ।। ७.६.४६ ॥
transliteration: iti te rāma sammantrya sarvodyogena rākṣasāḥ ।yuddhāya niryayuḥ sarve mahākāyā mahābalāḥ ।। 7.6.46 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, having thus deliberated with full preparation, all those Rākṣasas of huge bodies and great strength set out for battle.
